answer: Rewards sit in escrow and unlock one thirtieth a day, so a fresh identity waits a month for its first payout. A flagged account forfeits every locked token and its 500 POA bond. Fifty clones lock 25,000 POA and must stay clean thirty days; one shared-attestation sweep burns the escrow and bond. Payout becomes a jade statue carved slowly over a month instead of cash in hand. Each identity is its own island with no bridge to the others, and the longest road from staking to spending is what a sybil cannot survive. The nadir of a farm is a month of locked rewards one flag turns to dust.
